title: READ / REWRITE / DELETE ... INVALID KEY — random-access keyed-file error branch
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. KEYED-READ.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  POLICY-FILE.
       01  POLICY-REC.
           05  POLICY-KEY  PIC X(10).
           05  POLICY-DATA PIC X(70).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-LOOKUP-KEY PIC X(10).
      *> INVALID KEY branches when the key is not found (KSDS) or
      *> bounds-exceeded (RRDS). Functionally equivalent to file
      *> status 23 + 24, but inline syntactically.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       FIND-POLICY.
           MOVE WS-LOOKUP-KEY TO POLICY-KEY.
           READ POLICY-FILE
              INVALID KEY DISPLAY "missing policy: " WS-LOOKUP-KEY
           END-READ.
notes: INVALID KEY is the inline form of dup-key/not-found. The key-into-record assignment BEFORE the READ is the actual lookup mechanism — easy to miss on review. The spec must capture the 'key first, READ second' pattern.
